# dmh.dev | Dennis Martin Herbers

> Personal website, software projects, and blog of Dennis Martin Herbers.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://www.dmh.dev/): Profile, social links, and showcase of software projects and interactive web applications.
- [Blog](https://www.dmh.dev/blog): Articles and notes on software development, web design, and side projects.
- [Impressum / Legal Notice](https://www.dmh.dev/impressum): Bilingual (German/English) statutory legal notice pursuant to § 5 DDG and § 18 Abs. 2 MStV.
- [Datenschutzerklärung / Privacy Policy](https://www.dmh.dev/privacy): Bilingual (German/English) privacy policy pursuant to Art. 13 GDPR (DSGVO).

## Apps & Projects

- [Voynich](https://www.dmh.dev/voynich): Exploratory visual, linguistic, and computational research into the Voynich Manuscript (Beinecke MS 408) with a 4-segment morphological word analyzer, 98 folio walkthroughs, 115 specimen identifications, 227-folio corpus, 68 research guides, 520 high-resolution scans, and 265 structured datasets.
  - [Walkthroughs](https://www.dmh.dev/voynich/walkthroughs)
  - [Identifications](https://www.dmh.dev/voynich/identifications)
  - [Research Library](https://www.dmh.dev/voynich/library)
  - [227-Folio Corpus](https://www.dmh.dev/voynich/folios)
  - [Grammar & Atlases](https://www.dmh.dev/voynich/grammar)
- [Kaleidoscope](https://www.dmh.dev/kaleidoscope): Interactive WebGL shader kaleidoscope blending psychedelic fractal symmetry with sakura cherry blossom geometry.
- [dmh.dev Repository](https://github.com/d2kx/dmh.dev): Public repository for dmh.dev.
